# Buildiq

> Buildiq is an open-source citizen-developer app builder for the Nextcloud workspace.

Buildiq is an open-source citizen-developer app builder for the Nextcloud workspace. An app is navigation, pages, data (schemas) and business logic (flows). Users compose one from typed OpenRegister registers, OpenConnector connectors, OpenRegister flows, and DocuDesk templates, then lay out dashboard, index, detail and custom pages in a browser-based designer. Version snapshots roll back bad edits, ZIP exports move apps between instances, and RBAC keeps per-record access enforced through OpenRegister. Released under EUPL-1.2 and maintained by Conduction since 2019.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://openbuild.conduction.nl/docs/intro): main entry, including tutorials, user guide, and admin guide.
- [API reference](https://openbuild.conduction.nl/api): OpenAPI documentation.

## Optional

- [Install](https://www.conduction.nl/install): self-host on your Nextcloud instance.
- [Source code](https://codeberg.org/Conduction/buildiq): repository and issue tracker.
- [App page](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/buildiq): product positioning on conduction.nl.
